title: Auto-detect breaks and reset break counter
description: Detect user inactivity (e.g., 1 minute idle) and reset break counter. Also detect when laptop lid is closed / computer sleeps.

title: CLI integration for triggering pauses externally
description: Allow triggering pauses from command line so users can integrate with other tools, scripts, or automations.

title: Enhanced sliders with more options and manual input
description: Expand slider ranges for pause duration and repeated activation interval. Add option to type in exact values for all sliders instead of using the slider.

title: Color customization per activation type
description: Let users choose 1-3 colors to mix for breathing animation. Make this customizable per activation type: different colors for 'every' mode, random mode, and each individual scheduled activation.

title: Revamp blocked times with Apple Clock-style repeat system
description: Replace current daily + day-specific no-go times with unified system using Apple Clock-style repeats. Features: select days of week for repeating, auto-disable after firing (but keep in list), can be re-enabled. Depends on Pause-qu7 (Apple Clock-style repeat system for scheduled activations) - should share the same underlying repeat logic.

title: Limited bail-outs for locked sessions
description: Add optional one-time escape tokens for locked sessions. Settings: toggle on/off, choose how many bail-outs available, show remaining count. Include warning message like 'don't come here just to escape' to discourage misuse.

title: Multiple messages per session
description: Add 'add another message' button. Support: randomization with proportions, switching messages during session, displaying multiple messages side-by-side.

title: Apple Clock-style repeat system for scheduled activations
description: Add repeat options like iOS Alarm app (e.g., weekdays, specific days). Default behavior: scheduled activations automatically turn off after firing (one-shot unless repeats configured).

title: Pro tips in settings and notifications
description: Add helpful pro tips throughout the app - in settings menu sections and in notification messages.

title: Calendar integration for automatic blocked times
description: Connect to calendars (Apple Calendar, Google Calendar, etc.) to automatically create blocked times or schedule pauses around meetings.

title: Customizable scheduled reminders - add options for locked/unlocked, custom length, and custom message per scheduled activation
description: Per-scheduled-activation settings: locked (can't skip) vs unlocked, custom duration length, and custom message text.
